title_ar: الشيخ الددو يُحاضر بمدينة ازويرات بدعوة من جمعية المستقبل للدعوة والثقافة والتعليم
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Lectures in the City of Zouerate at the Invitation of the Future Association for Daʿwah, Culture and Education
body_ar:
ألقى فضيلة الشيخ العلامة محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء سلسلة محاضرات في مدينة ازويرات في 17 اكتوبر 2011 بدعوة من جمعية المستقبل للدعوة والثقافة والتعليم.

وقد ألقيت المحاضرة الأولى في مقر محظرة النساء بازويرات في التاسعة صباحا تحت عنوان: " تأملات في سورة الحجرات".

وفي الخامسة مساء ألقى الشيخ – حفظه الله- المحاضرة الثانية في مقر سينما ازويرات وهي بعنوان: "الإسلام مسؤولية وأخلاق"، وتم تنظيمها بالتعاون بين جمعية المستقبل للدعوة والثقافة والتعليم وجمعية بناء زمور.

كما ألقى فضيلته المحاضرة الثالثة والأخيرة بمسجد الرضوان وسط المدينة بعد صلاة المغرب وهي بعنوان " مفاهيم يجب أن تصحح" (مفهوم العبادة، التدين، الاستخلاف في الأرض).

وقد حضر هذا النشاط الدعوي الذي دعت له ونظمته جمعية المستقبل للدعوة والثقافة والتعليم جمهور غفير من شباب مدينة ازويرات إلى جانب الحضور المميز لكل الأعمار رجالا ونساء من جميع شرائح المجتمع.

للمتابعة: اضغط هنا
body_en:
His Eminence the learned Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, delivered a series of lectures in the city of Zouerate on 17 October 2011, at the invitation of the Future Association for Daʿwah, Culture and Education.

The first lecture was given at the premises of the women's maḥẓarah in Zouerate at nine in the morning, under the title "Reflections on Sūrat al-Ḥujurāt".

At five in the evening the Sheikh, may God preserve him, gave the second lecture at the premises of the Zouerate cinema, entitled "Islam is responsibility and character", organised in cooperation between the Future Association for Daʿwah, Culture and Education and the Bina' Zemmour Association.

His Eminence also gave the third and last lecture at the al-Ridwan Mosque in the city centre after the sunset prayer, entitled "Concepts that must be corrected" (the concept of worship; of religiosity; of stewardship on the earth).

This daʿwah activity, called for and organised by the Future Association for Daʿwah, Culture and Education, was attended by a large crowd of the young people of the city of Zouerate, besides a notable attendance of all ages, men and women, from every section of society.

flags.context: the title of the third lecture
options: Concepts it is obligatory to correct
flags.note: يجب here is ordinary Arabic 'must' inside a lecture title, not the technical wājib of the five-rulings table: its subject is a set of concepts, not an act of a legally responsible person, so the table does not apply and option 3 would invent a ruling out of a title. Recorded because يجب is exactly the word the style guide warns about, and because the lecture's content — which is not in this record — may well have contained real rulings.

flags.context: the venue of the first lecture
flags.note: Same term as in record 756 and it needs the same fixed corpus rendering, decided centrally. Note that this is a women's maḥẓarah, which is worth preserving exactly: the record shows the Sheikh lecturing at a women's teaching institution and to a mixed audience, and a rendering that flattens المحظرة into 'seminary' loses what kind of institution it is.

بناء is 'building' in both the literal and the figurative sense, and the association's own English name is not known from the record. Zemmour is the Mauritanian wilaya of Tiris Zemmour, in which Zouerate lies. The transliterated form is used rather than a guessed translation.

flags.context: the three concepts named in the third lecture's subtitle
options: worship; religiosity; stewardship on the earth
worship; religious practice; vicegerency on earth
worship; piety; succession in the earth
flags.note: الاستخلاف في الأرض is the Qur'anic idea that mankind is set on the earth as God's steward or successor (Qur'an 2:30, 6:165, and elsewhere). English has no settled rendering: 'vicegerency' is the term in the Islamic-studies literature but is opaque outside it; 'stewardship' is clear but carries an environmental colouring the Arabic does not have. The record gives the title only, with no content, so the lecture itself cannot settle the sense.

translator_notes: A short news report giving the titles, times and venues of three lectures and no content from any of them. Nothing in it could be mistaken for a ruling.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date and is not evidence of when the report was written. The body dates the lectures to 17 October 2011.
ازويرات is the mining city in northern Mauritania written Zouerate (also Zouérat, Zouérate) in Latin script; the commonest form is used.

The closing 'to follow, click here' is the site's navigation furniture; preserved in body_ar, recorded in source_download_link, omitted from body_en. The link is to a single item, while the record describes three lectures; which of the three it carries is not stated.
